title: T007 local dependency stack has static proof but runtime proof is pending
summary: T007 is dispatched from main@74b03ec4 with provider-neutral local PostgreSQL, S3Mock and OIDC Compose contracts. Static safeguards pass; the current runner has no Docker CLI, so container health remains unknown and T007 must stay unchecked.

claims.text: T007 uses loopback-only published ports, an internal Compose network, local placeholder values and pinned local-test images.
Compose parsing, shell syntax, help behavior and fail-closed behavior pass the available static proof.
